scope: Read-only review of frozen seven-file night illumination and guard performance patch; no source, Git or runtime mutation and no full-suite rerun.

nightEvidence.interpretation: The earlier night-only world SHA differs from final world because of the independently verified one-line guard retry change. Restoring only that old predicate reproduces the exact recorded night world SHA; all rendering additions are byte-identical.

analysis: Absolute-nearest shortcut preserves ascending-id ties and falls back to the original full scan if its nearest cell is blocked or its sampled line is rejected; early invalid-foot rejection is equivalent to the original line endpoint sample.

Directed fixed-grid edge keys cannot alias inside the current graph and are cleared on every setup. Production rebuilds navigation on floor/attempt/kind and collision hash changes; continuous line sampling, A* ordering and smoothing remain unchanged.

Initial guard search still occurs immediately because both kind/floor/attempt reset and navigation reconstruction set retry time to zero. Empty route retry is now limited by the original260ms deadline; reaching a finite waypoint still allows immediate replanning.

Night image/matte/runtime frame shading is presentation-only; both reality modes keep authored biography target and controller dispatch. Existing mode crossfade/blackout masks are replayed only over replaced portrait pixels. Texture and illumination sampling is cached by stable resource paths and target id.
limits: Focused automated headless evidence does not replace root computer-use night visual and DEV112 walking/Space acceptance.

The specific previously observed25-second GUI instance is not uniquely attributed to guard navigation; separate old-code measurements and negative controls demonstrate the fixed expensive path/retry behavior.
Linux/Godot4.6.3 evidence from e9dcd316 predates this patch and must not be reused as final exact-head evidence.
